items.category: probe artefact, not a scheme defect
items.location: Section 5.x refinement probe at the wall rows
items.evidence: C5/B5: interior rows converge at order 2 (2.1e-04 metric discrepancy) while the first row shows an O(1) discrepancy of the finite-difference metrics against the analytic ones; the one-sided stencils used there are themselves exact on quadratics with error (h^2/3) f-prime-prime-prime
items.action: no change to the code or the acceptance criteria; the finding and its cause are recorded here and in REPORT 7 so that a reader reproducing the probe is not misled
items.note: kept open on purpose: it is a record, not a defect to fix

items.evidence: B1: CV = 1 - s tau + (s tau)^2, MCV3 = 1 - 5/4 s tau + 5/2 (s tau)^2; the second-order coefficients differ (1 against 5/2) so the forms are matched at first order only, while tau_eff = 5/4 tau holds at leading order
items.action: any sentence that could be read as claiming agreement beyond the leading term must name the order; the companion's wording is to be checked and, if needed, tightened
